title: 第一卷 第11章 迎娶王雨馨第一卷 第12章 老头续命
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 林逸来到王开山家门前，深吸一口气，叩响院门。
“来了，来了！”
“林老哥，竟然是你！”
“快进来坐！”
王开山开门，看见是林逸，脸上顿时笑开了花，热情招呼林逸进去。
院里，王雨馨正在晾晒灵稻，看见林逸，小脸一红，低下头去。
“雨馨，给你夫君倒水！”
王开山嘿嘿一笑，提醒道。
王雨馨应了一声，端着水碗过来，手指都在发抖。
“夫君……喝水……”
王雨馨主动改口，声音细若蚊蝇，耳朵根都红透了。
“多谢雨馨！”
“开山老弟，我今天来，是正式提亲的？”
林逸接过碗，喝了一口后，正色道。
“何时拜堂？”
王开山眼睛一亮，搓着手，满脸期待问道。
“聘礼我准备了两块下品灵石，等手头宽裕了再补上，雨馨嫁过来，我一定好好待她！”
林逸将一块灵石递过去。
“林老哥，你这是干啥！说了聘礼免了！”
王开山连连摆手，推辞道。
“必须收！”
“这是规矩，雨馨嫁过来，不能让人笑话！”
林逸极力坚持道。
当初他娶柳婉儿这个凡人女子，还花了两块下品灵石。
王雨馨同样值得！
尽管他现在手里很拮据，回头种植青灵蹈也需要不少本钱。
但他还是咬牙拿出了两块下品灵石当聘礼！
“老林哥，雨馨交给你，我放心？”
王开山收起灵石，拉着林逸坐下，笑容灿烂道。
“林老哥，你能种植青灵蹈，赚的更多，比我强多了！”
“我那五亩灵田，就交给你打理了！”
“当做雨馨的陪嫁！”
“我平时给你帮忙忙！”
“你让我们老两口，别饿死就行！”
王开山投桃报李，主动说道。
直接送给林逸一份丰厚嫁妆！
“丈人第，你放心，我一定把田种好，给你养老！”
“让你余生无忧！”
林逸闻言大喜，不由用力拍着王开山的肩膀，连声许诺道。
王开山主动将灵田交给他种植，他就不用厚着脸皮开口了。
“太好了！”
王开山闻言，笑得合不拢嘴。
傍上了林逸，真是少走五十年弯路！
“对了！”
“还有一件事，赵猛那小子，最近老在咱们西郊转悠，鬼鬼祟祟的，你得提防着点！”
content_en:
Lin Yi came to the door of Wang Kaishan's house, took a deep breath and knocked on the courtyard door.
"Coming, coming!"
"Brother Lin, it's you!"
"Come in and sit down!"
Wang Kaishan opened the door and saw Lin Yi. His face suddenly burst into laughter and he warmly welcomed Lin Yi in.
In the courtyard, Wang Yuxin was drying the spiritual rice. When she saw Lin Yi, her face turned red and she lowered her head.
"Yuxin, give your husband some water!"
Wang Kaishan smiled and reminded.
Wang Yuxin responded and came over with a water bowl, her fingers trembling.
"Husband... drink water..."
Wang Yuxin took the initiative to change her words, her voice was as thin as a mosquito, and her ears turned red.
"Thank you Yuxin!"
"Brother Kaishan, I'm here today to formally propose marriage?"
Lin Yi took the bowl, took a sip, and said seriously.
"When will you worship?"
Wang Kaishan's eyes lit up, he rubbed his hands and asked with expectation.
"I have prepared two low-grade spiritual stones as a betrothal gift. I will make up for it when I have more money. If Yuxin gets married, I will treat her well!"
Lin Yi handed over a spiritual stone.
"Brother Lin, what are you doing! I said I would waive the betrothal gift!"
Wang Kaishan waved his hands repeatedly and declined.
"It must be collected!"
"This is a rule. When Yu Xin is married, you can't be laughed at!"
Lin Yi insisted.
When he married Liu Waner, a mortal woman, he spent two low-grade spiritual stones.
Wang Yuxin is equally worthy!
Although he is very strapped now, planting Qing Ling Dan will still require a lot of capital.
But he still gritted his teeth and took out two low-grade spiritual stones as a betrothal gift!
"Brother Lin, I can rest assured that Yuxin will be left to you?"
Wang Kaishan put away the spirit stone, pulled Lin Yi to sit down, and said with a bright smile.
"Brother Lin, if you can grow Qingling Dance, you can make more money. You are much better than me!"
"I'll leave my five acres of spiritual land to you!"
"As Yu Xin's dowry!"
"I usually help you!"
"As long as we, the old couple, don't starve to death!"
Wang Kaishan reciprocated the favor and said proactively.
Give Lin Yi a generous dowry directly!
"My father-in-law, don't worry, I will cultivate the fields well and provide for you in your old age!"
"Let you have no worries for the rest of your life!"
Lin Yi was overjoyed when he heard this. He couldn't help but patted Wang Kaishan on the shoulder and promised repeatedly.
Wang Kaishan took the initiative to hand over the spiritual field to him for planting, so he didn't have to be shameless to speak.
"Great!"
When Wang Kaishan heard this, he smiled from ear to ear.
Being with Lin Yi saved me fifty years of detours!
"Right!"
"One more thing, that boy Zhao Meng has been wandering around our western suburbs lately. He is so sneaky, you have to be careful!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Marrying Wang Yuxin Volume 1 Chapter 12 The old man continues his life
